tools.name: invitations_list

tools.name: invitations_revoke

tools.name: account_acceptTerms

tools.name: account_mfaSetup

tools.name: account_mfaDisable
tools.description: Signed-in session only: turn two-step sign-in off with your password and a current code or recovery code. SAGOT staff cannot use the platform console without it.

tools.name: account_mfaRecoveryCodes
tools.description: Signed-in session only: replace all recovery codes after confirming a current code. Returns the 10 new codes once.

tools.description: Signed-in session only: delete your own SAGOT account after confirming your password. tools.name: assistants_preview

tools.name: assistants_authorize
tools.description: Signed-in session only: allow (with a workspaceId) or deny an AI assistant's request to use SAGOT. Allowing gives that assistant the listed scopes in one workspace — never admin, never more than your role — and returns redirectTo, the address to send the browser back to.

tools.name: assistants_list
tools.description: Signed-in session only: AI assistants connected to your account through OAuth, with workspace, scopes, when connected and last used.

tools.name: assistants_revoke
tools.description: Signed-in session only: disconnect an AI assistant. Its access and refresh tokens stop working immediately; it must ask again to reconnect.

tools.name: assistants_clients_create
tools.description: Signed-in session only: create an OAuth client ID and secret for an assistant that asks for them, such as Gemini Enterprise (redirect https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/oauth-redirect). The secret is returned once. People who sign in through it still choose their own workspace.

tools.name: assistants_clients_list
tools.description: Signed-in session only: OAuth client IDs you created for assistants, with their redirect addresses.

tools.name: assistants_clients_revoke
tools.description: Signed-in session only: revoke an OAuth client ID you created; assistants using it can no longer sign in or refresh tokens.

tools.name: members_invite
tools.description: Admins: invite an email to this workspace with a role, optionally limited to agentIds (viewer/editor/operator only). tools.name: members_transfer

tools.name: members_remove

tools.name: lines_test

tools.name: lines_clearAlert

tools.name: platform_overview
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Platform totals: accounts, workspaces (active/suspended), calls today and in 30 days, connected minutes, active calls, charges, lines with problems, pending support requests and waitlist.

tools.name: platform_health
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Health of the database, worker, media (LiveKit), email outbox and paired gateway devices, with the deployment's concurrent-call ceiling and current active calls. Read-only.

tools.name: platform_staff_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). People with a platform role (owner, admin, support, finance). Bootstrap owners come from the server configuration and cannot be revoked here.

tools.name: platform_staff_grant
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires the staff scope. Give an existing account (by email) a platform role. Owners grant any role; admins grant support or finance. Replaces the account's earlier platform role. Takes effect on the next request.

tools.name: platform_staff_revoke
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires the staff scope. Remove an account's platform role. Admins cannot revoke owners or admins; the last owner and bootstrap owners cannot be removed.

tools.name: platform_audit_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Append-only log of platform actions and staff reads under support access, newest first; filter by actorId, targetId or operation.

tools.name: platform_workspaces_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Every workspace with owner, members, lines, 30-day calls and charges, status and limits. Search by workspace name or owner email. No customer content.

tools.name: platform_workspaces_get
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). One workspace: owner, members and roles, lines with health, agents, 30-day usage, calling policy summary, suspension, limits, credits and recent platform actions. No transcripts, recordings or contact details.

tools.name: platform_workspaces_suspend
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. Suspend a workspace with a reason shown to its members: they can still read and export, every other action fails WORKSPACE_SUSPENDED, queued outbound calls are canceled and inbound calls are not answered.

tools.name: platform_workspaces_reactivate
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. Lift a workspace suspension. Calls canceled during the suspension stay canceled.

tools.name: platform_workspaces_limits
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. Cap how many calls the workspace carries at once across all its lines (1–50, null = no workspace cap). Line capacity and the deployment ceiling still apply.

tools.name: platform_accounts_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Every account with email, name, created time, workspaces, platform role and suspension. Search by email or name.

tools.name: platform_accounts_get
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). One account: workspaces with roles, platform role, active sessions and API keys count, suspension.

tools.name: platform_accounts_suspend
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. Suspend an account: its sessions and API keys stop working and sign-in is refused until reactivated. You cannot suspend yourself or a platform owner.

tools.name: platform_accounts_reactivate
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. Allow the account to sign in again. Revoked sessions and API keys stay revoked; the person signs in again and creates new keys.

tools.name: platform_lines_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Phone lines across workspaces with provider, mode, capacity, live health, telco warning and active calls. problems=true lists only lines that are unhealthy or have a warning. Never returns secrets.

tools.name: platform_calls_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Call metadata across workspaces, newest first: workspace, direction, line, status, outcome, duration, charge. Numbers are masked; no transcripts or recordings.

tools.name: platform_blocklist_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). SAGOT's platform do-not-call list.

tools.name: platform_blocklist_add
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. Add a number to the platform do-not-call list: no workspace can call it; queued calls to it are canceled. Customers see only that the number is on SAGOT's do-not-call list.

tools.name: platform_blocklist_remove
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. Remove a number from the platform do-not-call list.

tools.name: platform_usage
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Usage for a month (YYYY-MM, default this month) per workspace: calls, connected minutes, charges, credits and net, with platform totals. Rates are proposed (docs/11); no payment is collected.

tools.name: platform_credits_grant
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires billing. Credit a workspace (centavos, PHP) with a reason the customer sees. Credits are append-only; correct one with a negative amount.

tools.name: platform_credits_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Credits granted, newest first; filter by workspaceId.

tools.name: platform_settings_get
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Platform switches: managedLiveCalling (SAGOT number lines in live mode may call any number in a supported country) and whether payments and SAGOT numbers are configured on this deployment.

tools.name: platform_settings_update
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. Turn live calling from SAGOT numbers on or off for every workspace. Off: live-mode SAGOT lines call only their verified numbers again, effective before the next dial. Audited.

tools.name: platform_access_request
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires support. Ask a workspace's owner and admins for read-only support access for 1–72 hours, with a reason they see. Nothing is accessible until they approve.

tools.name: platform_access_list
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Your support access requests and grants with status (pending, active, denied, expired, ended — withdrawn or revoked) and expiry.

tools.name: platform_access_end
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). End your own pending request or active support access early.

tools.name: platform_subprocessors_notify
tools.description: Platform staff only (account session). Requires manage. tools.description: Workspace admins: SAGOT support access requests and grants for this workspace, with what staff read while access was active.

tools.name: support_approve
tools.description: Workspace admins: approve a pending SAGOT support access request. The staff member gets read-only access for the requested hours, starting now. Nothing can be changed by staff.

tools.name: support_deny
tools.description: Workspace admins: deny a pending SAGOT support access request.

tools.name: support_revoke
tools.description: Workspace admins: end active SAGOT support access immediately.
